title: Evolution (Daniel Oliva Barbero)
lede: A textbook vaporwave collage: two cyan statues, an Ionic column carrying a glitched Windows logo, a pink Paint window, palms, a striped sun, and a pink grid over blue.
summary: Statues, column, glitched Windows logo, pink Paint window, palms, striped sun, grid floor. 2019.

evidence.note: Inspected a 1920 × 2560 rendering of the 8554 × 11405 file on Wikimedia Commons, in a scratchpad copy. Not stored.

styles.note: Clear: it combines every diagnostic in one image, with pastel pink, violet, and cyan, a Windows 9x window, classical statues, palm trees, and a grid floor under a striped sun.

context: Commons lists it under CC BY 2.0 from Flickr, while the author’s description says CC BY 4.0 and that it was “created from” another Flickr work. [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vaprwave_97346.png).
observed: A mauve sky frames a yellow-to-pink sun cut by horizontal pink stripes.
A pink-tinted Microsoft Paint window with a navy title bar, tool palette, and colour swatches overlaps the left side.
A cyan Ionic capital and column carry a glitched, pixelated Windows flag logo in the centre.
Two identical cyan-and-violet statues of a draped woman face each other, each holding a small hexagonal pattern.
Pale pink palm trees stand at both sides; a magenta grid floor on blue recedes to the horizon.
interpretation: The most complete single statement of the rubric found in open sources. It is also a warning: the style depends on quoting other people’s trademarks and interfaces.
borrow: Tint real classical figures in a single pastel duotone so they read as cut-outs rather than photographs.

rights.statement: The author released the file under an open license (CC BY 2.0 on Commons, CC BY 4.0 in the description), but a Microsoft Paint window and the Windows logo are central to the composition, so no image is stored here.
